hardware._host_note: One machine, not two. Schema 2.0 retired hardware.egpu / hardware.compute_node: there is no CUDA node and no eGPU. host_kind is the SHELL this session reached the laptop through — Claude Code desktop may hand a bash block to Git Bash or to WSL2, and they report different truths about the same hardware (see hardware_compute ARTIFACT B wsl_memory_law).

gpu.name: Intel integrated graphics
gpu._note: vram_gb is null by design: the iGPU borrows from the same 16 GB memory_gb already governs. Reporting a number here would double-count it.

power._note: A gate, not a readout: every workload class except llm_local_sm requires AC.

thermal._note: Two independent readings of one limit; at least one must be readable or the gate closes. cpu_perf_pct is the load-bearing one on this chassis.

local_llm._endpoint_note: Ollama on the Windows side. From WSL2 under default NAT networking 'localhost' is the WSL VM, not the laptop — local_rag_orchestration §1 P2a rewrites the host to the WSL gateway.
local_llm._tiers_note: PROVISIONAL — these tags are the shape of the registry, not a verified inventory of this machine. Run `ollama list` and correct them; local_rag_orchestration §1 P2b verifies the tag before any call and fails loudly rather than silently substituting a model.

pipeline._note: Live execution state for the current run. Project memory lives in vault/ as Content MDs, not here.

active_variables._note: Run-scoped only. Disposable between runs. Anything that must survive to the next session belongs in the task's Content MD (Router.md §8).

registries.context_note: Router.md §3 gates resolve to context/brand/<name>.context.md at L0. Three are authored — visual_identity, typography_system, color_science — transcribed from css_html_ui ARTIFACT A, which was already in force and is machine-verified by check_palette_parity (DECISIONS.md D9). The other seven are unauthored and still park at L3 per §5. An authored gate is not the same as a complete one: visual_identity §7 and color_science §5 name what they do not answer, and a route needing those constraints treats them as unresolved. context/domain/ holds reference libraries: retrievable material that never satisfies a mandatory gate. See context/brand/README.md.
